text:
sara: Hey team :wave: Quick sync re: lexical stewardship. I ran a sweep and found mixed usage for the ‘runtime’ concept across docs + SDK snippets: 'inference runtime', 'model runtime', 'serving runtime'. There are ~12 occurrences in docs + 4 in SDK examples. I propose we standardize on 'serving runtime'. Thoughts?

mike: +1 for 'serving runtime' — it captures the platform/runtime distinction better.

jane: Agree. Curious about customer-facing contexts where 'inference' might be clearer. Any examples?

sara: Good point. I checked quick contexts: user guides use 'inference runtime' mostly in deep-dive sections. API reference uses 'model runtime' in param docs. For customer-facing quickstarts, 'serving runtime' reads less jargon-y.

ellie: From product POV, 'serving runtime' is fine. It'll also align with Dedicated/Private docs where we already talk about 'serving'.

kevin: I'll flag SDK snippets. There's one example that does:```js
// old
const client = new RedwoodClient();
const runtime = client.modelRuntime('gpt-4');
await runtime.generate({ prompt });
```
We should update to:```js
// new
const client = new RedwoodClient();
const serving = client.servingRuntime('gpt-4');
await serving.generate({ prompt });
```

jane: Thanks @kevin — we should also provide a tiny migration note in the SDK migration guide: map modelRuntime -> servingRuntime.

sara: Agreed. Plan: 1) canonicalize term in docs repo (docs PR), 2) update SDK snippet repo (sdk-examples PR), 3) add one-line migration snippet in SDK migration guide, 4) run a link/grep pass to catch missed mentions.

mike: I can take the docs PR. I'll do a staged change: search/replace in guides + follow-up manual checks for ambiguous pages. PR will be small and scoped.

sara: Awesome. Mike - include a changelog entry in PR body and tag @jane for UX wording review.

mike: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (WIP).

docs-bot: CI queued for PR #4123 — docs spellcheck, linkcheck, and snippet-lint.

kevin: I'll open SDK PR for snippets and add migration note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pull/789 (ready for review).

ellie: Once both PRs land, we should update the glossary record with an entry: 'serving runtime — canonical term for the runtime that performs model serving/inference; replaces "inference runtime" and "model runtime".' Who will update glossary?

jane: I can update the glossary. Will add cross-links and the migration note.

sara: Nice. Action items: 
- mike: docs PR (#4123) to replace variants + changelog (due EOD Thu)
- kevin: sdk snippets PR (#789) + migration note (due EOD Thu)
- jane: glossary + UX check (due Fri)
- sara: run final grep & post a short announce in #docs when deployed

mike: Quick Q: should we leave old terms in parens on product pages? Eg "serving runtime (formerly 'inference runtime')" for one release cycle?

ellie: Yes, please do that for any customer-facing pages for at least one release cycle. Include a short footnote.

sara: Great. I'll add that to the PR checklist.

kevin: One more: update sample CLI snippet too — there's a `--runtime` flag in examples. I'll rename flag references in examples but leave API param names untouched until SDK release.

jane: Sounds cautious and correct.

sara: Thanks everyone :white_check_mark: I'll post a short summary when PRs merge.

kevin: ping @sara when sdk-examples PR merges and I'll push the migration note into the docs migration guide as well.

docs-bot: Ticket created: DOCS-5277 "Lexical stewardship: consolidate runtime terminology" (assignee: sara).
